lines.text: Pinch a mallet to pick it up.
lines.spoken: Pinch a mallet to pick it up.

lines.text: Fingertips play the bars too, a little softer.
lines.spoken: Fingertips play the bars too, a little softer.

lines.text: Mallets sound fuller. Pinch one from the tray.
lines.spoken: Mallets sound fuller. Pinch one from the tray.

lines.text: Open your hand to put a mallet back.
lines.spoken: Open your hand to put a mallet back.

lines.text: Strike near the middle of a bar for warmth.
lines.spoken: Strike near the middle of a bar for warmth.

lines.text: For long notes, alternate mallets quickly on one bar.
lines.spoken: For long notes, alternate mallets quickly on one bar.

lines.text: Strike, then hold the mallet down for a short note.
lines.spoken: Strike, then hold the mallet down for a short note.

lines.text: Quiet a bar: rest a hand or mallet on it.
lines.spoken: Quiet a bar: rest a hand or mallet on it.

lines.text: Sharps are the back row. Strike their nearest tip.
lines.spoken: Sharps are the back row. Strike their nearest tip.

lines.text: Strike each bar as its block lands.
